newsitem.title: PORTUGAL: Portuguese shares pulled down by PT, Telecel.
newsitem.headline: Portuguese shares pulled down by PT, Telecel.

text.p: 1730 GMT - Portuguese shares closed lower, dragged down by telecommunications shares Portugal Telecom and mobile phone operator Telecel. The shares failed to react favourably to a buy recommendation by SBC Warburg which recommended the purchase of shares in Portugal Telecom and Telecel after PT's TMN mobile phone unit, Telecel's only direct rival, announced price cuts.

* The star of the session was Banco Pinto e Sotto Mayor, which is emerging as the flagship bank of Antonio Champalimaud, dealers said. BPSM hit a high of 1,320 escudos before closing at 1,292 escudos, up 48, in volume of 481,793 shares.
